title: Refactor CI roster and add dependency visibility probe
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Introduce a CI roster manifest to centralize runner allocation
Add a dependency-visibility probe that surfaces changed transitive deps in presubmits
Route lint/test pipelines through the roster for deterministic runner assignment
description: Context: Our presubmit lanes have drifted: team-level overrides in multiple workflows caused opaque runner selection and CI capacity imbalances. This made it hard to reason about which changes impact longtests or dependency-heavy workflows. Motivation: centralize runner/queue assignment into a small CI roster and provide a lightweight probe that surfaces the dependency delta for any PR. That allows presubmit routing to make deterministic decisions (fast-lint lane vs. longtest) and surfaces risky dependency bumps before they land. Approach: 1) Introduced ci/roster/manifest.yaml (a minimal, human-editable roster) and a tiny roster resolver used by the presubmit router. 2) Added a dep visibility probe (ci/probes/dep_visibility.go) that computes the transitive dependency delta between base and head and annotates the PR with a short summary (top-5 added/removed transitive packages and whether they touch native modules). 3) Refactored the presubmit router (scripts/presubmit-router/main.go) to consult the roster manifest and the dep probe when deciding which lanes to trigger. 4) Updated presubmit workflow (.github/workflows/presubmit.yml) to call the roster resolver early and to attach probe output as a CI artifact/annotation. 5) Added docs/ci/roster.md describing operational runbook and failure modes. Checklist: - [x] roster manifest format and schema validated - [x] dep probe unit + integration tests - [x] presubmit router integration with the roster - [x] small smoke run against staging runners - [x] docs and runbook updated Commits summary: - 1/ci: introduce roster manifest and basic resolver - 2/infra: dep visibility probe with unit tests and small integration harness - 3/presubmit: route through roster and attach probe annotations - 4/docs: add runbook and troubleshooting hints Changed areas/files (high level): ci/roster/manifest.yaml - new (manifest of runner pools and allocation hints) ci/probes/dep_visibility.go - new (Go probe; calculates dependency delta against base commit) scripts/presubmit-router/main.go - modified (now queries roster resolver and probe) .github/workflows/presubmit.yml - modified (calls resolver + probe; uploads annotation) docs/ci/roster.md - new (operational runbook) tools/ci-ctl/README.md - modified (small helper to preview roster) go.mod/go.sum updates - added probe deps (a small semver library) package.json - bump for action helpers Why this is safe: The roster is additive and feature-flagged via PRESUBMIT_USE_ROSTER. Existing workflows fall back to the legacy selection logic when the flag is not set. The dep probe runs in read-only mode; it never mutates repository state. Test coverage: Unit tests for dep delta logic (edge cases: lockfile-only changes, removed packages, native modules), end-to-end presubmit smoke against staging runners to validate routing decisions, and a compatibility pass that runs the old selection logic side-by-side for three sample PRs. Review conversation (high level): - Marcus Reed (reviewer): "Can the dep probe be run cached for PRs that rebase frequently? Also pls add a short TTL to annotations so we don't flood UI." Author (Aisha): "Added a small file-level cache with a 15m TTL; annotations are compacted and rotated after 24h (see tools/ci-ctl/README.md)." - Elena García: "Please ensure the roster manifest is validated on merge (schema validation check)." Author: "Added a JSON schema check in presubmit validation step; fails fast if invalid." - Priya Singh: "What about longtests that must never run on small instances?" Author: "Roster entries can mark pools as 'no-longtest' and the resolver enforces that; documented in roster.md." Approvals: Marcus Reed approved after cache TTL change; Elena and Priya gave thumbs-up after schema validation and pool annotations. CI details: - presubmit: lint (pass) - unit-tests (pass) - probe-integration (pass) - e2e-staging-smoke (pass) There was one transient runner allocation failure in an early run; re-run fixed the job. Merge notes: Squash merge used. Rollout plan: Flip PRESUBMIT_USE_ROSTER for internal teams first, monitor presubmit failure rate and queue wait times for 48h, then enable org-wide. Operational hooks: - If roster resolver experiences >5% allocation errors over 1h, fallback to legacy selection and send paged alert to CI-oncall. - Dep-probe annotation size limited to 1.5KB; if exceeded, the probe uploads a summarized artifact and a short annotation with link. Related work items: ENG-4123 (roster design spike), ENG-4190 (dep probe POC), SUP-1021 (customer-reported flaky presets). Files changed (detailed list): ["ci/roster/manifest.yaml","ci/probes/dep_visibility.go","scripts/presubmit-router/main.go",".github/workflows/presubmit.yml","docs/ci/roster.md","tools/ci-ctl/README.md","go.mod","go.sum","package.json"] Reviewer comments extract: ["Marcus: add caching + TTL for probe output","Elena: add schema validation for manifests","Priya: add pool-level restrictions for longtests","Aisha: replied with implementation + tests and addressed comments"] QA instructions: Run ./tools/ci-ctl preview-roster --manifest ci/roster/manifest.yaml to validate resolver decisions locally. To test dep probe locally: go test ./ci/probes -run TestDepDelta and run scripts/presubmit-router with PRESUBMIT_USE_ROSTER=1 against a known staging PR. Post-merge actions: - Apply roster entries for two internal teams in rotation (ops ticket created) - Monitor presubmit latency dashboard for anomalies for 72h - Add small follow-up to sanitize probe output for very large monorepos (ENG-4230)
